conditions.text: Legal must resolve the UCI 360 research-only restriction before prototype use proceeds beyond method-building
Access request submitted to Environment Monitoring Unit for station readings, station list and coordinates, and VR-03 closure status

agreements.reason: Single road-level device with a research-only licence conflict and -200 sentinel values. Feasible for prototype method-building only; verdict matches the evidence.
The 2024-03-18 method change with no documented adjustment is confirmed in the wiki and the catalog has no note. Partial-met verdict is correct; this is the largest production risk.
Host refused by the allowlist guardrail as designed. Not-feasible verdict is correct. catalog.data.gov must not be added to the allowlist.

traced_conclusion.could_change_if: If the Environment Monitoring Unit provides a backfill of station readings before 2023-01-01, the prototype window gap for N1 could be partially closed and the source could serve both windows rather than production only.
